In Pokémon Gamma Emerald, on your way to your new home your trip takes an unexpected turn when a sudden storm appears and your boat crashes on a mysterious, uncharted island situated between the Hoenn and Sinnoh region. With no way to call for help or outside contact, you are forced to explore- but you are not alone.

Mercenaries and Team Magma have entered the island to take its secrets and power in order fulfil their mission. As you traverse lush jungles, ancient ruins and damaged battlefields , you'll get better as a trainer and become stronger and face Team Magma, uncover their secrets and put a stop to it.

478701.overview:
Project Reignition is a Fan Remake of Sonic and the Secret Rings for PC, developed by a team led by KumaPauZ. The full Version 1.0 will publicly release for Windows and Linux/Steam Deck on August 31, 2026.

Not unlike Sonic P-06 before it, Reignition aims to recreate the game from the ground up while improving on its visuals and gameplay, allowing one to play through Secret Rings with full analog controls (though a motion control option will also be available), along with removing redundant skills and making level progression clearer to the player. Reignition also adds new remixes and music to the Secret Rings experience to make the audio feel less repetitive.

The game's demo release history is:

June 2024 (pre-v0.1): The initial demo, containing three missions from Sand Oasis.
September 2024 (v0.1): Contained all Sand Oasis and Dinosaur Jungle missions. Released for the SAGE 2024 showcase.
January 2025 (v0.2): Added all Evil Foundry missions.
August 2025 (v0.3): Added all Levitated Ruin and Pirate Storm missions. Released for the Sonic Fan Fest 5 showcase, but quickly supplanted by v0.4 a few weeks later.
September 2025 (v0.4): Added all Skeleton Dome missions. Released for the SAGE 2025 showcase.

The final public build of Reignition prior to Version 1.0's release would be v0.4.2, which includes all missions barring the Lost Prologue and Night Palace stages. Version 1.0 will feature a complete Adventure mode with all story missions and cutscenes from the original Sonic and the Secret Rings, along with a brand new Time Attack mode. Post-v1.0 releases will include HD remakes of the game's 2D cutscenes and the Party Mode from the original release.

479028.overview: An experimental Windows, Linux, and Android port of the Pokemon Emerald decompilation.

479147.overview: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

479604.overview: Picayune Dreams is a roguelike blend of bullet heaven horde survival, and bullet hell gameplay. Adrift across the endless void, you must fend off thousands of nightmarish and otherwordly creatures. Uncover a mysterious and surreal story. And don't forget. You mu [TRANSMISSION INTERRUPTED...]

479710.overview: A native port of Tony Hawk's Project 8 (Xbox 360, 2006), built by static recompilation. It is not an emulator: the game's PowerPC code is translated to C++ ahead of time and compiled into a normal executable for your machine.

479720.overview: This project intends to port Project Gotham Racing 4 to PC / any x86_64 hardware (provided they can run an exe).

479859.overview:
PaperKlay is a 3D platformer collect-a-thon where you open, unfold and rotate your way through a world made out of cardboard, paper, clay and other handcrafted materials.

Join the duo Chick & Nugget on a creative adventure as they journey across a paper and cardboard filled world that will rotate and unfold your reality in order to save all of the lost eggs!

Master a variety of moves to explore the world! Double-jump, dash and sprint your way through levels, or use your glider to reach new heights. Your sidekick Nugget has his own unique way of solving puzzles, too!

479894.overview: Pinyon Shift is a Windows-only playable preview of a native recompilation of the Xbox 360 release of Forza Horizon.

480140.overview:
Pippo is a remake of a simple arcade-style game released for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum by Mastertronic in 1986.

Help Pippo to jump on all the blocks in his world  and turn them into a colour he likes. Watch out for the nasties patrolling the blocks, they will do anything in their power to hamper Pippo's progress and send him falling to oblivion. One particular nasty little specimen will even change the colour of the blocks back again leaving Pippo where he started.
Fortunately, energy pills will appear every so often. GRab one of these and your enemies will all turn into springs. Pippo can then go and knock them all off the platforms.

Also on hand to help is Tenerino - Pippo's Son - who traverses the blocks with a stash of extra lives! 

Arrow keys or Q, A, O, P move Pippo around the board, or use a gamepad
Control, Space or gamepad Fire to select option on menus
F1 or gamepad Start to pause the game

480378.overview:
A fork of the Perfect Dark PC port, which is itself a port of the Perfect Dark decompilation.

It adds movement the N64 game never had — jump, a combat roll, melee combos, a third person camera — raises the Combat Simulator simulant cap from 8 to 80, keeps bodies lying where they fell, and gives you a free-flying spectator camera, a screenshot key and a video recorder for watching the results.

480414.overview:
Princess Trainer: Gold Edition is an adult training game based upon Disney's Aladdin. It is set after Witch Trainer, taking place in the Harry Potter universe, which in turn takes place just after Magic Shop events.

In this game players control Genie, who had to grant the evil Jafar's three wishes and ended up being a human. With Aladdin out of the picture, Jafar wants to marry Jasmine but needs her made submissive and servile. Genie, who lost his memory after the third wish from Jafar, starts working for him.

Genie gets to control Jasmine and gradually turn her into a sex slave. He needs to train her becoming more obedient and having less shame. Whilst doing this he meets Rose where Jasmine gets her obedience classes, and Azaela from the local clothing shop where he buys outfits for several girls.

The game also features a brothel, one of the many types of jobs Jasmine needs to work to earn Genie some money. Lola, the spoiled daughter of the brothel madame eventually ends up at Genie's house, just like Iris, daughter of Maslab, local bartender.

Lola, a girl who grew up at the brothel still acts like a spoiled brat. She wants to become a prostitute but her adoption mother wants a better life for her. So, she leaves her home and joins Genie, who she always calls 'old man'. It turns out she has hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD), meaning: having no sex drive whatsoever. Through quests Genie helps her with overcoming HSDD. Iris, daughter to Maslab, as some daddy issues. She wants to become a prostitute to thwart her father, who doesn't allow her to do any sexual activity, like dancing on the tables in his tavern or being groped by the customers. Saying she wants to be treated as a 'normal' girl, she does some pretty 'abnormal' things, like walking on the street naked, becoming a prostitute, wanting to be hit and chocked during sex, amongst others. She eventually starts living with Genie and works at both her father's tavern and the brothel.

After training Jasmine fully, Genie turns her in to Javar. He gets some flashbacks and gets his memory back. Javar however, took Jasmin with him on their wedding day and used her as a sex slave in front of most people of Agrabah. Jasmine gets scolded by the people and nobody has any trust in her whatsoever anymore as a princess. Javar's plan succeeded. Genie returns home and meets Iris and Lola. He discusses his past memories with Iris and they both decide they'll be doing something about this, helping out Jasmine. In an extended ending it's shown that they meet with Iago, Jafar's parrot. Some time in the future Genie and Iris are using the brothel as a staging ground. Together with Maslab and his brother, Lola and some others they are making their plans to help Jasmine. They are greeted by their lastest member, Aladdin. The game ends with this cliffhanger.

Gameplay mainly consists of sending Jasmine on jobs to earn money, so you can train her to become the slave Jafar wants.

480550.overview:
A native PC port of Lost Odyssey for the Xbox 360 (December 31, 2007). This recompilation includes enhancements such as higher resolutions and doubling the original framerate from 30fps to 60fps. This was created with a hybrid method which utilizes both native CPU execution and emulated GPU execution relying on the graphics backend and translation layers from the Xenia Xbox 360 Emulator.

A man without a past fights for a world without a future.
From famed creator Hironobu Sakaguchi of Mistwalker comes a revolutionary RPG experience rich in depth, emotion, and cinematic gameplay. In an age that has harnessed the dark power of magic, you are the mysterious, immortal Kaim — on a quest to reclaim 1,000 years of lost memories. Surviving violent wars and encountering friends, lovers, and enemies, you will discover the true meaning of both sorrow and joy.

480984.overview:
A native PC port of Pilotwings 64 for Windows and Linux, made by statically recompiling the game with N64Recomp.

Features:

-Widescreen at your display's aspect ratio, with the HUD at the screen edges
-High frame rate through matrix interpolation, up to your display's refresh rate
-No black overscan border
-Instant screen changes (the original stalls up to six seconds on some menus)
-Launcher with graphics, sound and controls settings, remapping and mod support
-Keyboard and controller support

481392.overview:
ROARR! Sounds like trouble. Did that come from Dino Island? It looks like Rex needs the PAW Patrol to save the day! Mayor Humdinger’s causing chaos. Dinosaurs are scared and running wild. Help them get back to their families safely.

Leap into a colossal, open-world with Chase, Marshall, Rubble, Skye, Rocky, and Zuma. First stop, PAW Patrol Mobile HQ with Ryder to find out what rescue missions you’ll em-bark on as your favorite Pup. Run through the Dino Plains looking for eggs. Stop by the Paleo Center, where Heidi and Eugenia will teach you how to care for your new dino friends. Decorate their enclosures to make them feel like home. Sniff out collectibles across the sandy shores and discover rocky caves with secret pools. Switch to vehicle mode to drive through a jungle, filled with tall trees, long vines and tropical fruits.

Create roar-some new looks for your pup, your vehicle, and dinosaurs and complete every mission stomping in style. Dive into fun minigames and discover dino-sized surprises solo or team up with a friend in two-player mode

Can you stop the chaos and make it to the volcano before it erupts? With the help of dino experts, Rex and Timmy, you can.

481393.overview:
Piece by Piece is a literal puzzle-platformer where each level is fragmented into jigsaw pieces.

With 100 handcrafted levels across 12 puzzle box, Piece by Piece will test even the most hardcore of puzzle solvers with new types of puzzle pieces that combine in puzzles the deeper you get. A cozy art style and an ethereal soundtrack keep you in flow as you solve your way through each puzzle box.

481558.overview:
Native PC port of P.T. (2014) by Kojima Productions

P.T. (Playable Teaser) is a first-person psychological survival horror video game directed by Hideo Kojima, developed by Kojima Productions, and published by Konami. Released for the PlayStation 4 on 12 August 2014 as a free download on the PlayStation Network, P.T. served as an interactive teaser for the game Silent Hills, a cancelled installment in the Silent Hill series. In P.T., the player explores a looping corridor of a haunted house while experiencing supernatural events.

481880.overview: Parasite Black is a mature, dark fantasy RPG set in the world of Mirnos, where a deadly race known as the Demorai threatens everything. With your newfound "gift," you may hold the key to turning the tide of war and saving the realm from destruction.

481939.overview:
Without fear, you signed the contract which would forever sever your ties to the world above, and now it is your sworn duty to brave the abyss and uncover the secrets of the old world. Your death is guaranteed, but so is your status as a legend.

The ever-shifting abyss provides an adequate challenge to fearless dungeoneers, but don't get too reckless as you only have one life to prove yourself with. Central to this plight is the dynamic of holding your position and pushing ever forward as hoards of monsters try to break your foothold; they are quite numerous afterall, and you'd do well to stand your ground. Don't stall for too long however, or a terrifying force might make itself known and attempt to steal your glory!

482010.overview:
This is a video game about Jimothy's presumed-dead best friend Jarvis turns out to be alive, and in possession of a space laser he intends to point at a city - so Jimothy goes to the Cuban jungle and drops Jarvis off a satellite dish.

Project Midas is a work-in-progress PC port of GoldenEye, built from the N64 decompilation. It runs on Windows and Linux and reads its game data from your own copy of the US cart.

482115.overview: A standalone launcher for Halo 3 from Halo: The Master Chief Collection, built to be the ultimate way to play Halo 3 multiplayer. It adds games for up to 128 players, four-player split screen that plays online, Halo 3's and Halo 3: ODST's campaigns and ODST's Firefight in co-op for up to 16 players, a theater that records every game you play, dedicated servers, a server browser, playlists with lobby voting, scripted game modes, an expanded Forge with Halo 3's AI, in-game moderation and anti-cheat, and runs on your own copy of the game.

482195.overview:
Paper Lily is a story-driven, psychological horror RPG where each puzzle has multiple solutions and outcomes. There is always another way.
Follow Lacie's story as you explore a dangerous hidden world, solve puzzles in multiple different ways, and face strange enemies. The game is playable in about 4 hours and contains multiple endings depending on your actions.

Paper Lily - Chapter 1 is the continuation to the prologue, Project Kat, but it can also be enjoyed without having played it.

482256.overview:
S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

A LONE JOURNEY AGAINST FATE
Framed for murdering his master, Soul suffers a devastating wound to the heart, leaving him just sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted, he roams the Wulin, determined to unravel a conspiracy that has ensnared the martial world. Through rain and blood, kindness and vengeance, he embarks on a journey where love and hatred intertwine in search of a heart.

INTO THE PHANTOM WORLD
Explore the mysterious Phantom World, where shifting light and shadow conceal mysteries at every turn. Memory Flowers, the Wulin and the Discordance, Transcension, the Lady of the Veil, Inanis' Dreamscape... Every secret leads to another, and every corner hides a new story. When one path ends, another begins. Hidden passages and intricate mechanisms await those who dare to explore.

A SEAMLESS DANCE OF BLADES
In the Wulin, your weapon is your life. Master over 30 primary weapons and more than 20 unique Phantom Edges, wrested from the hands of fallen foes. Rooted in traditional martial arts, combat flows through seamless combos that are easy to learn yet rewarding to master. Only true masters will uncover the deadly intricacies within every technique. Blades clash in showers of sparks. Dodge, deflect, counter, and strike in one seamless flow, where victory and defeat are decided in an instant. Will the next turn leave the sands stained with blood, or lead you back from the brink of death?

KUNGFUPUNK: A NEW VISION OF WUXIA
The golden age of wuxia cinema collides with punk fantasy in Phantom Blade Zero. Martial arts, cold steel, mechanical prosthetics, crumbling industrial ruins, traditional Chinese aesthetics, and modern rock music. Together, they create the dark, unmistakable aesthetic of kungfupunk.

REAL KUNGFU IN EVERY MOVE
Powered by Unreal Engine 5 and cutting-edge motion capture technology, renowned martial arts choreographers from the golden age of wuxia cinema collaborated to bring authentic Chinese kungfu to life. Every strike and stance in Phantom Blade Zero is rooted in real martial techniques. Experience the timeless allure of Chinese kungfu through breathtaking cinematic action.

482552.overview:
Petka 8: Pokorenie Rima is another part of one of the most famous Russian quest series.

A hero of Russian communist revolution and many funny stories as well Vasily Ivanovich Chapaev with his silly henchman Petka and the most sexy girl in the village Anka the machine-gunner are into some adventures again. Something strange is going on around. People are losing memory, comissar Furmanov is dead and unknown terror is lurking nearby. Starting from their homeland brave party will investigate the mysterious events happening in Gadyukino, fight the imperialistic aliens in space, get into the loony bin and even travel through time to ancient Rome accompanying action with a lot of jokes. As always there are some historical persons made into ludicrous figures.

Petka 8 is presented in totally 3D environment for the first time in series but still holds the traditional point-n-click gameplay.

482553.overview:
The ninth installment in the long-running Russian adventure game series, subtitled Proletarskiy Glamur ("Proletarian Glamour"), once again follows the adventures of the titular Petka, his commander Chapaev, and the sexy Anka - all real participants of the Russian Civil War of 1918, who became the target of countless jokes during the Soviet period. This time, the trio receives an assignment to travel to the year 2150! It appears that in 2008, the USA and other countries decided to use Russia as a dumping ground for garbage. Fearing that the Russian would object such treatment of their country, the Americans used an advance technique to brainwash them, rendering them helpless. Such is the situation when the heroes arrive in New Moscow of the 22nd century, determined to save their homeland...

Proletarian Glamour is a puzzle-solving adventure game. The player advances the story by talking to characters, and completing various tasks, mainly involving manipulation of inventory items. Just like the previous installment, the game is done in full 3D, both for characters and background graphics.

482558.overview:
Young Hiroki has been sick all his life. His father died when he was young, and his mother is distant. Even with all of this, he thinks of himself as a pretty normal guy, except that he's completely dependent on his childhood friend, Ayano, who enjoys taking care of him while his mother is away.

One day, Hiroki's mom calls and tells him, "I'm hiring a 'private nurse' for you", but Hiroki strongly objects. He doesn't even know what a "private nurse" is, but he knows he doesn't want one ... until she's standing in his doorway, dressed in a sexy nurse uniform.

"Hi, I'm Maria. I'm your new private nurse!". She promises to cure Hiroki of his disease within a month. While unbelievable, he tentatively accepts and the treatment begins. Her methods are very "hands on", and Ayano watches with mixed feelings as Maria treats him. As his treatment intensifies so do feelings of love and jealousy. What kind of treatment will Maria use to finally cure Hiroki, and will Ayano just quietly watch and do nothing?

482637.overview:
Nebula runs Super Mario Galaxy natively on Windows. Nebula contains no Nintendo code or assets; you need your own copy of the game.

In Super Mario Galaxy, Princess Peach is invited to the Star Festival, but Bowser interrupts by kidnapping her and stealing her entire castle using a fleet of airships. Bowser sends Mario flying out into deep space. Mario lands on a small planet and meets Rosalina, a mysterious woman who looks after star-like creatures called Lumas, and her Comet Observatory. Rosalina asks Mario to help her collect Power Stars and Grand Stars to power up the observatory so they can travel to the center of the universe and rescue Princess Peach. After traveling through various cosmic galaxies, defeating bosses, and gathering enough stars, Mario reaches Bowser's galaxy. He defeats Bowser, rescues Peach, and a new universe is born as the Lumas sacrifice themselves to save everything.

482683.overview: Pong, Pac-Man and Space Invaders share one competitive arcade playfield. A ball travels through a maze, collects points and sets further threats in motion while two players defend their sides. Watching your paddle is only part of the challenge: events inside the maze demand attention as well. Familiar rules combine into a fast duel with several simultaneous objectives.

482696.overview: An adult-themed pinball game built around a single fictional table and a straightforward high-score challenge. Control the flippers, rescue the ball from the drain and hit scoring features that trigger bonus imagery. Erotic drawings accompany successful shots. Its simple presentation keeps the focus on basic pinball reactions and maintaining a productive run.

482705.overview: A Czech text-driven adventure with adult humour. Players visit locations, hold conversations, and choose actions while trying to pursue romantic encounters. Progress involves managing money, selecting options from menus, and finding the sequence of activities that opens further opportunities.

482848.overview: This is an educational puzzle game starring the Pink Panther, in which players travel across the Solar System to repair damaged research stations on six planets. The game combines light educational elements with casual logic-based mini-games aimed at younger audiences. Gameplay is structured around a planet selection map, allowing players to visit Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, and Uranus. Each planet hosts a distinct activity, such as logic puzzles, pattern recognition, or color matching. Visiting Earth, Neptune, or the Sun provides additional educational information about those celestial bodies. Completing all six activities restores the stations and concludes the mission. Each completed task rewards the player with a collectible planet picture in an in-game album that contains facts about the corresponding planet. After finishing all missions, players can replay activities to unlock clips from classic Pink Panther cartoons. Activities include: Reversi – a digital version of the classic strategy board game; Guess the Code – a number-based logic puzzle using feedback clues; Complete the Path – a tile rotation puzzle to reconnect paths; Color Board – a match-style color-clearing puzzle; Shape Match – a reflex-based shooting game identifying matching shapes; Sequence Maker – a sequencing and pattern-ordering puzzle.
